101.value: 1, 2 and 3: spent fuel is highly radioactive, fuel is enriched, and a control failure can cause a meltdown
101.reasoning: Statement 1 is correct: spent fuel holds intensely radioactive fission products. Statement 3 is correct: if the control system fails, the chain reaction and heat can run away and melt the core. Statement 2 is accepted as correct by UPSC's key because most power reactors in the world (light-water reactors) run on uranium enriched to about 3-5% U-235. Note that India's pressurised heavy water reactors run on natural uranium, so statement 2 is a generalisation; the key treats it as true. So all three statements are correct.
